# Vehicle and Motorised Assets
These are modifiable SOP's that can be changed by a Commanding Officer.
## General If a vehicle or other general motorised asset is deployed for any reason, the following regulations apply. - The Commanding Officer may override any decisions relating to vehicles or other motorised assets. - Authority over ground vehicles (including tanks, Humvees, APCs, and similar assets) rests with the Vehicle Commander. If no Vehicle Commander is assigned, responsibility defaults to the Engineering Officer. - Authority over air vehicles rests with the Fighter Pilot, followed by the Fighter Systems Officer and then by the rest of the flight crew if no pilot is assigned. - Operating vehicles is restricted to the assigned crew. For operating a ground vehicle, request permission from the Vehicle Commander. For operating an air vehicle, request permission from the pilot. - Synthetics may be utilised as drivers for vehicles that do not possess weapons. - Command staff may utilise vehicles so long as it does not violate their deployment SOP’s. - Unless altered by the Commanding Officer, vehicle crews are allotted one ground vehicle. Fighter pilots are allotted one air vehicle.
